laws.rule: Aceh is a special territory where Sharia police enforce Sharia regulations that don't apply elsewhere in Indonesia. They are intended for Muslims but can be applied to non-Muslims, including foreigners, in some circumstances. Gambling and prostitution are banned.
Drinking alcohol is not allowed under Aceh's Sharia regulations.
Same-sex relationships, sex outside marriage and living together before marriage are not allowed.
A conservative standard of dress is required.

Aceh's Islamic criminal code (Qanun Aceh 6 of 2014 on Hukum Jinayat, in force since October 2015) applies to every Muslim in Aceh. It also applies to a non-Muslim who commits an offence in Aceh together with a Muslim and chooses to submit to it, and to a non-Muslim whose act is an offence under the qanun but isn't covered by Indonesia's Criminal Code or other national criminal law (Article 5). Businesses operating in Aceh are covered too.
laws.penalty_signal: Caning, fines set in grams of pure gold, imprisonment
laws.heading: Qanun Aceh 6 of 2014 on Hukum Jinayat, Article 5

laws.rule: Khamar means any intoxicating drink, or any drink with 2% alcohol or more. Drinking it: 40 lashes; a repeat offence adds up to 40 more lashes, a fine of up to 400 g of pure gold or up to 40 months' prison. Producing, storing, selling or bringing it in: up to 60 lashes, 600 g of gold or 60 months. Buying, carrying or giving it: up to 20 lashes, 200 g of gold or 20 months.
laws.penalty_signal: Up to 60 lashes, 600 g of gold or 60 months' prison
laws.heading: Qanun Aceh 6 of 2014 on Hukum Jinayat, Articles 1, 15 and 16

laws.rule: Khalwat (an unmarried man and woman who aren't close relatives being together, by consent, in a closed or hidden place in a way that leads towards sex) carries up to 10 lashes, 100 g of gold or 10 months; some cases go to customary (adat) courts instead. Ikhtilath (intimate contact such as kissing, hugging or touching between a man and woman who aren't married, in private or in public) carries up to 30 lashes, 300 g of gold or 30 months. Arranging, hosting or promoting either carries higher penalties.
laws.penalty_signal: Up to 30 lashes, 300 g of gold or 30 months' prison
laws.heading: Qanun Aceh 6 of 2014 on Hukum Jinayat, Articles 1, 23 to 25
